name: Noel Berry
life: “I still remember delivering a meal still labeled for yesterday's ward.” People around the corner by Juniper Tailor know Noel by a small Saturday habit. Noel looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I took a lunch for a patient and forgot to sign. I've come back to put the right name beside the debt.
appearance: Noel is easy to recognize by a cropped cut that shows the shape of the ears and a straight nose and deep-set eyes. Usually dressed in a gray fisher's sweater with a watch on a cracked leather band, Noel takes off the watch before a long conversation when listening.
personality: Noel has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Noel's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To add the correct patient name to the account.
family: Leah Smith is Noel’s cousin raised in the same household. Noel makes the call. Leah is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The salon on strike*, Leah says, “I thought a free manicure made it fair. The technician asked who would watch her sleeping children.”
connections: Nicholas Mitchell. Two separate meal debts get recorded correctly before the till reopens. Also in the story is Nadia Holland (counter note taker).

reactions.situation: A manager asks for the handwritten sandwich tally
reactions.response: Noel makes sure customers' names needn't travel with the tally.
reactions.asWritten: A manager asks for the handwritten sandwich tally. Noel makes sure customers' names needn't travel with the tally.

reactions.situation: Smoke appears under a shop door after closing
reactions.response: Noel alerts the nearest occupied shop, stays outside and writes down when the smoke first appeared.
reactions.asWritten: Smoke appears under a shop door after closing. Noel alerts the nearest occupied shop, stays outside and writes down when the smoke first appeared.

reactions.response: Noel seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Noel seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
